scope: Independent offline artifact and document consistency audit after root signals final engine freeze, first fresh evaluation completion, final ZIP and reports are ready.

executionBoundary.beforeStartSignal: Read scripts, previous RUN007 audit procedure and historical evidence only. Do not read fresh v10 dataset, QA or result content.
executionBoundary.afterStartSignal: Read explicitly named final freeze/aggregate/result/package/report records. Verify dataset files as binary hashes only; do not use fresh page labels or fixture content for tuning.

checks: Hash every declared product/tool freeze entry against current bytes and explicit frozen archive bytes.
Check full current src and extension manifest coverage dynamically; do not carry forward RUN007's fixed fifteen-file count after new modules.
Verify prior freeze pointer/hash and any pre-first tool revision record without replacing prior freezes.
Capture opening and closing hashes to distinguish artifact stability from product validation.
Confirm command start/completion bind the correct engine and dataset freeze hashes and report hash.
Confirm phase is fresh-blind-validation and first output was not overwritten; retain nonzero quality failure separately from execution failure.
Check declared dataset/supporting hashes and read-only bits without interpreting fresh fixture, URL or annotation contents.
Cross-check initial-screen counts, per-institution status and separate additional-menu totals across aggregate report, release gate and prose.
Preserve initial failure, correction/provenance chronology and original/v2 distinction when applicable; do not count two versions as two source pages.
Compare historical evidence/datasets/packages to explicit Git tags or frozen hash records, never to current product source.
Include run-004-v0.5.0-dev, run-005-v0.6.0-dev, run-006-v0.7.0-dev and run-007-v0.8.0-dev scopes as appropriate.
Verify RUN007 v9/v2 freezes, tool-error attempt, first evaluated failure and source archives remain byte-identical.
Keep v6/v7 annotation corrections as ADJUDICATED_DEVELOPMENT and previous original/parent hashes intact.
Check archive byte length and SHA256 against package report and SHA256SUMS.
Run ZIP integrity check; reject duplicate, absolute, traversal or unexpected paths and compare every entry byte to current dist.
Check sorted names, fixed 1980 timestamp, stored compression and 0644 regular-file attributes against deterministic package metadata.
Confirm source manifest, dist manifest and archive manifest are identical, package version matches, MV3 activeTab/scripting only, no host/optional permissions or automatic injection.
Verify saved two-build/two-archive/source-stability records and package source/build digests; do not claim an independently repeated build.
Cross-check local verification summary with raw Playwright statistics, failure/flaky/skip counts and recorded stage exits.
Match automatic accessibility and synthetic performance evidence to their exact source hashes, sample counts and documented scope.
Keep existing analyzer/overlay thresholds separate from stricter whole-pipeline diagnostic, preserving every PASS and FAIL.
Check same-source development modes, suite row count, unique exposed-page count and aggregate arithmetic without treating adjudicated or repeated data as fresh.
Treat prior live public-task observations as historical unless newly observed; never relabel HTTP/guidance arrival as authentication/application/payment or human success.
Check README, AGENTS, WORK_SPEC, PROGRESS, RUN008, INSTALL, PRETEST, SUPPORT_MATRIX, ACCESSIBILITY, VALIDATION and evaluation README current pointers.
Resolve relative local Markdown file links in relevant repository documentation; list unresolved paths separately from external URLs and section anchors.
Check each headline number and cited artifact against saved evidence, including exposed sample totals after fresh first evaluation.
Keep maximum six plus other/previous menu policy, direct ordinary HTTP navigation and input/risk/currentness protections explicit.
Keep native install, actual VoiceOver speech, actual browser zoom and pretest/formal participant observations at their evidenced states; do not infer completion.
Require the release gate and documents to agree on original ten-stage scope and NOT_MET unless every original acceptance requirement actually has evidence.
Keep usage snapshot boundary and unknown elapsed/account billing/token/cost fields honest.

plannedOutputs: audit.json: bounded audit result, checks, findings, resolved-during-audit notes and limitations
hash-checks.json: expected/actual hashes and comparison scopes
historical-preservation.json: named Git tag/scopes and mismatches
zip-entries.json: exact archive entry hashes and dist equality
markdown-links.json: checked relative references and unresolved paths
limits: Artifact consistency is separate from quality, safety, performance, accessibility, installation and human acceptance.
File read-only bits are permission evidence, not a guarantee against privileged later mutation.
Link checks establish local path existence; external destinations and section anchors are not part of this audit.
No fresh v10 content, QA or results have been read during this preparation task.
